metadata.repeat_notation_interpretation: Unnumbered repeat signs interpreted as two total performances. Final chorus x8 interpreted as eight total performances of the written eight-position line, rather than eight additional performances.

metadata.harmonic_rearticulation_policy: Two consecutive A7sus4 bars in each bridge represented as one held harmonic position; terminal Em7 ending continues the final chorus Em7 position. Drum fill has no declared harmonic event. This decoder cannot time identical-chord rearticulation.
metadata.slash_bass_limitation: A/G# is preserved in supplied labels; existing equal-pitch-class templates ignore slash bass and cannot acoustically distinguish it from A.
